title: Bill Starr’s Legendary Split
author: Matt D.
desc: Bill Starr was one of the few athletes who excelled in all three iron sports back in the day. He was nationally ranked in the top five in Powerlifting and Olympic Weightlifting. Although he dabbled in bodybuilding, he mostly held disdain for the sport. His basic workout was consistent wherever he went, and he always trained at the same time. The longest streak of not missing a workout was a remarkable 17 years. Starr never missed a session for holidays, special occasions, or travel days. Starr was very scheduled and only traveled on his rest day, which was Saturday. He referred to it as his “slug day” – the only day he rested during the week. According to Olympic Coach Dick “Smitty” Smith, Starr was one of the strongest individuals he had ever seen. This was his basic workout. Basic, maybe, but intense? You better believe it. If it was good enough for one of the most legendary lifters in history, it’ll surely pack muscle onto anyone else.
